use core.files as files
use core.process as process

fn json_escape(s: String) String -> {
    result := s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\t", "\\t")
    return result
}

fn run() {
    path :: process.argv().get(1) ?? panic("missing path")
    text :: files.read(path) ?? panic("read failed")
    raw_lines :: text.lines()

    name := ""
    count := ""
    note := ""

    loop line in raw_lines {
        trimmed :: ~line.trim()
        if trimmed.is_empty() -> next

        parts :: trimmed.split("\t").to_list()
        if parts.len() < 2 -> next

        key :: parts[0]
        val :: ~parts[1]

        if {
            key == "name" -> name = ~val
            key == "count" -> count = ~val
            key == "note" -> note = ~val
        }
    }

    count_int :: count.to_int() ?? panic("count is not a number")
    escaped_name :: json_escape(name)
    escaped_note :: json_escape(note)

    print("{{\"count\":{count_int},\"name\":\"{escaped_name}\",\"note\":\"{escaped_note}\"}}")
}
